name: size of database.txt
content: SELECT ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1024/1024/1024, 2) AS size_gb FROM dba_data_files;

name: tablespace free space.txt
content: SELECT tablespace_name, ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1024/1024, 2) AS free_mb FROM dba_free_space GROUP BY tablespace_name;
